title: Blueberator's dark GUI
description: A dark unique GUI style resource pack with crosshair, hud and GUI.
body:
### Information

The **Blueberator's dark UI** is a texture pack that **overhauls** the game's **HUD** and **GUI** into a  new dark style. It is **simplistic** and changes most of the default GUI. 

Includes new _enchanced_ HUD, dark GUI and smaller crosshair.~~~~
